# Copilot instructions → AGENTS.md

Thin pointer. The canonical agent instructions for MirrorBuddy live in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root — read that file.

Why: `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md` used to carry three
overlapping copies of the same rules, all loaded in every agent session. One source now.

Path-matched domain rules in `.github/instructions/` still auto-load as before.
